source: EEOC notice of proposed rulemaking, Rescission of EEO-1 and related reports
sample: Primary instrument — no survey sample applies
volatility: high — this item moved between the drafting of ai301-defensible-m1 and 12 August 2026. Re-check before any deployment.

claims.claim: The EEOC voted to advance a notice of proposed rulemaking rescinding the EEO-1 and related reports; the NPRM was published in the Federal Register on 23 July 2026
The rule is proposed, not final. Current EEO-1 filing obligations stand until a final rule issues
claims.canonicalWording: Never state this as an obligation that has ended. Proposed, not final; obligations stand.

cautions: The teaching point is not the administrative relief. It is that a baseline may disappear and baselines cannot be reconstructed backwards — decide now whether to keep the series internally.
ai301-defensible-m1 currently describes an earlier stage of this rulemaking (submission to OIRA on 14 May 2026, review expected within 90 days). That is now superseded — tracked as S-12.
